entries.name: result
entries.type: if merged = some 0 then rows = [] ∧ after = before else rows = [((), after)] ∧ after.core = assimilated before.core target source (.unenumerated merged (sourceScs ++ targetScs)) ∧ after.core.values[source]? = some .eliminated ∧ after.core.values[target]? = some (.unenumerated merged (sourceScs ++ targetScs)) ∧ after.expandable source = false ∧ (∀ (slot : Nat), slot ≠ source → slot ≠ target → after.expandable slot = before.expandable slot)

entries.name: ranges
entries.type: if source = target then True else match before.core.values[source]?, before.core.values[target]? with | some (.unenumerated (some left) _), some (.unenumerated (some right) _) => match lookupNode beforeCaller.checked.native.machine.heap left, lookupNode beforeCaller.checked.native.machine.heap right with | some first, some second => SourceCurrentAllocatedNativeRequestBounds.WordRanges (.code (SourceRecursiveIntersectionCode.requestNode IntersectionEmptyDomain.emptyDomain first second)) beforeCaller.checked | _, _ => True | _, _ => True

entries.type: SourceCurrentConjunctionMemo.Call 1000 beforeCaller.fourth query (physical queried) answer reachedPhysical afterCaller.fourth
